youtube_url.description: The YouTube URL for audio/video pipeline.

manual_download.description: Toggle to use the manually downloaded files.

stream_id.description: An optional, human-readable identifier for this stream.

trim.description: Optional trim shared by the audio and video pipelines, so both always cut at the same moment. Times are H:MM:SS or HH:MM:SS.

audio.description: Configuration for the audio-only pipeline (intro, outro).

manual_path.description: The path to the manually downloaded audio file. Any format ffmpeg can read (wav, mp3, m4a, ...).

output_format.description: Format of the finished audio file.

intro_url.description: An optional S3 or HTTP URL for the audio intro.

outro_url.description: An optional S3 or HTTP URL for the audio outro.

video.description: Configuration for the video+audio pipeline (intro, outro).

manual_path.description: The path to the manually downloaded video file.

intro_url.description: An optional S3 or HTTP URL for the video intro.

outro_url.description: An optional S3 or HTTP URL for the video outro.
